module.letterboxd.name: TSQ Letterboxd
module.letterboxd.description: Posts the followed Letterboxd member's new reviews, rated diary entries and rewatches from the official RSS feed once to a channel; a later change of an entry updates its card.
letterboxd.config.channel_invalid: This channel cannot be used: it must be a text channel in this server that the bot can see.
letterboxd.config.saved: Letterboxd cards will now go to {0} (account: {1}). Only entries from now on are sent; the history is not posted.
letterboxd.config.saved_missing_permissi: Saved: {0}. Warning: the bot is missing permissions there ({1}); cards cannot be sent.
letterboxd.config.no_channel: First pick a channel with /tsq-admin modul:letterboxd islem:configure.
letterboxd.pause.done: ⏸️ Letterboxd cards paused. Entries made while paused are not sent later.
letterboxd.resume.done: ▶️ Letterboxd cards resumed. Only entries from now on are sent.
letterboxd.preview.synthetic: Preview — SYNTHETIC SAMPLE (not a real entry); not sent to the channel.
letterboxd.preview.real: Preview — the latest real entry worth a card; not sent to the channel.
letterboxd.status.title: TSQ Letterboxd status
letterboxd.status.account_changed: WARNING: this server was configured for {0} — configure again
letterboxd.status.mode_live_delivery_dry: Live, but delivery mode is DryRun (Delivery:Mode)
letterboxd.status.feed_value: last successful read {0} · last result {1} (HTTP {2}) {3} · consecutive failures {4} · next check {5}
letterboxd.status.baseline_value: baseline {0} · last feed {1} entries · mode active {2}
letterboxd.status.baseline_none: none yet — set by the first successful read; those entries are not sent
letterboxd.status.stale: ⚠️ Stale source: the last successful read is older than the catch-up window — not a proven loss, coverage is uncertain
letterboxd.status.conflicts: ⚠️ Identity conflict: {0} item(s) ignored in the last read (not merged)
letterboxd.status.gap: ⚠️ Potential coverage gap ({0}): the new feed shared no entry with the known ones — how many were missed is unknown
letterboxd.status.ratings_source_value: BLOCKED — stars given without a diary entry are not in the RSS feed; the official API is not open to personal projects; reading HTML pages automatically is against the Terms of Use. No source is used.
letterboxd.status.coverage_partial: PARTIAL — reviews, rated diary entries, unrated/unreviewed rewatches and entry edits are supported; standalone ratings and their changes are not.
letterboxd.doctor.title: TSQ Letterboxd diagnostics
letterboxd.doctor.mode_off: Letterboxd:Mode=Off — no feed requests, no cards
letterboxd.doctor.mode_live_delivery_dry: Live, but Delivery:Mode is DryRun so cards are simulated
letterboxd.doctor.account_changed: this server was configured for {0}, configuration says {1} — delivery stopped; configure again
letterboxd.doctor.channel_gone: {0} not found or not visible to the bot
letterboxd.doctor.channel_ok: {0} · View Channel, Send Messages, Embed Links OK
letterboxd.doctor.history_missing: no Read Message History (optional): an uncertain send cannot be checked in the channel
letterboxd.doctor.feed_value: last success {0} · last attempt {1} · result {2} (HTTP {3}) · consecutive failures {4} · next {5} · {6}
letterboxd.doctor.items_value: {0} entries · {1} skipped (list/other/invalid) · observed window {2} items · oldest {3} · last card {4}
letterboxd.doctor.baseline_value: {0} — the history of the first read was not sent
letterboxd.doctor.baseline_none: none yet: set by the first successful read, those entries are not sent
letterboxd.doctor.mode_since_value: {0} since {1} — new entries dated after it are sent even if the first successful read comes later; in this mode's first read a change of an existing entry cannot be dated and opens no new card
letterboxd.doctor.stale_value: last successful read {0} (older than {1} hours, or none): NOT a proven loss, but entries of that period are not seen yet; entries older than {1} hours are not sent later
letterboxd.doctor.coverage_gap_value: {0}: the whole feed (observed window {1} items) consisted of unknown entries; some entries in between MAY have been missed, how many cannot be known
letterboxd.doctor.conflicts_value: {0} item(s) of the last read showed other content/another film under a known viewing id: ignored, the stored entry and its card are unchanged
letterboxd.capability.review_diary: {0}: {1} — reviews and diary entries from the official RSS feed
letterboxd.capability.unrated_rewatch: {0}: {1} — an unrated, unreviewed rewatch is also a feed entry
letterboxd.capability.entry_edits: {0}: {1} — a rating/rewatch/review change of an entry in the feed window updates the same card
letterboxd.capability.standalone_ratings: {0}: {1} — stars without a diary entry and their changes are not in the feed; no permitted source was found
letterboxd.doctor.coverage_partial: PARTIAL — standalone ratings are not supported; going live is the owner's decision
letterboxd.doctor.terms_value: Only the member's public RSS feed is read (15 min, one request). Letterboxd's official API page states every profile has an RSS feed of diary entries, reviews and lists; its help page describes auto-publishing via RSS (not readable from this environment). This is no permission to crawl HTML and no TSQ-specific approval.
letterboxd.health.coverage_partial: partial — standalone ratings are not supported
